title: Lost-Dose and Travel Reserves in Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Scheduling
content:
**Tailwise Pharmacy memo — early-refill overrides and the Autoship dosing calendar**

Lost or travel doses shorten the usable supply of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship before anything else is applied. The fills are read from the Tailwise Pharmacy fill records of the linked prescription and of the prescription it renewed (the earlier prescription the linked one is a renewal of), including the override reason recorded on each fill.

1. When a fill of the linked prescription, or of the prescription it renewed, was dispensed in the last twelve months under an early-refill override for lost or damaged medication, 6 days are held back from the days of supply one shipment carries, as a standing reserve against another lost dose, never going below zero.
2. When no such lost-or-damaged override exists in that period but a fill of either prescription was dispensed in the last twelve months under a travel override, the days of supply one shipment carries are multiplied by 95 percent and rounded down to a whole day.
3. Otherwise the days of supply one shipment carries are used in full.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

## Truth table

| Lost-or-damaged override fill in the last twelve months | Travel override fill in the last twelve months | Usable days of supply |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or No | days carried less 6, not below zero |
| No | Yes | days carried multiplied by 95 percent, rounded down |
| No | No | days carried, in full |

## Worked figures (hypothetical days of supply carried)

- 90 days, a lost-or-damaged override fill on the earlier prescription eight months ago: 84 usable days.
- 90 days, only a travel override fill in the period: 90 multiplied by 95 percent is 85.5, rounded down to 85.
- 30 days, only a travel override fill: 28.5, rounded down to 28.
- 4 days, a lost-or-damaged override fill: 0 usable days (never below zero).
